test_title: PYST 5: SSC JE EE- General Intelligence (Held On 10 Oct 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option that represents the letters which, when sequentially placed from left to right in the blanks below, will complete the letter series

Q _ R _ _ _ U R _ A _ _ R L A

options.text: R A L Q L A Q
A L Q U Q L U
U L A Q L Q U
Q L U Q L A U

solution:
Checking options one by one:

1) Q *__**R**__* R **A L** / *__**Q**__* U R *__**L**__* A / *__**A Q**__* R L A → doesn't follow any pattern

2) Q ***__A__*** R ***__L Q__*** / ***__U__*** U R ***__Q__*** A / ***__L U__*** R L A → doesn't follow any pattern

3) Q ***__U__*** R ***__L A__*** / *__Q__* U R *__L__* A / ***__Q U__*** R L A → follows a pattern (Q U R L A)

4) Q ***__Q__*** R ***__L U__*** / *__Q__* U R *__L__* A / *__A U__* R L A → doesn't follow any pattern

Hence, the correct answer is "**U L A Q L Q U**".
